$comment: The modules an app copies with `kit add`. Files live in src/; `requires` pulls other modules in; versions are the ranges the kit is tested with. `web` modules run in the browser and go to the app's frontend (`--dir src/components/vector-search`); `cli.mjs registry` also builds them as shadcn items in r/.

core.description: createAgentApi: OpenAPI 3.1 + Scalar docs, HAL links, problem+json, API keys + Access, ETags and Cache-Control, Idempotency-Key and rate limits, discovery (api-catalog, Link headers, robots.txt, Markdown for agents), a key-value store type; an OAuth server plugs in from the `oauth` module

db.description: The app's database through Drizzle: `openDb` (node:sqlite, Turso/libSQL, or any async Drizzle SQLite database), `migrate` (each feature's steps, recorded in `kit_migrations`), `testDb`; `dbGuardStore` (idempotency and rate limits shared by every instance)

oauth.description: The app as its own OAuth server: metadata, `/oauth/*`, agent registration (auth.md), ES256 tokens; `createOAuth`, `dbOAuthStore`, `memoryOAuthStore`, `generateOAuthKey`

pagination.description: Cursor pages and sorting: limitQuery, cursorQuery, sortQuery, pageOf, pageSchema

guide.description: The agent guide from Markdown templates (llms.txt, agents/, skills/), its generated parts (endpoints, tools, playbooks, how to get unstuck) and the skills discovery index

mcp.description: An MCP server (2026-07-28) over the app's own routes: tools, resources, prompts, skills, and its Server Card

a2a.description: A2A 1.0 over the MCP tools: the Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json and a JSON-RPC endpoint (SendMessage, GetTask, ListTasks, CancelTask) whose skills are tools

vectors.description: Gemini Embedding 2 through OpenRouter: look (image) and meaning (text) vectors, append-only ledgers that never pay twice, budgets and spend caps, nearest and standouts search (sharp, for pictures only)

vector-search.description: Search by words, by picture and by likeness over the vectors: three documented routes (rate-limited where they cost) and the MCP tools that call them

web.description: The front door: a public landing page at /, the browser app under /app behind the sign-in, old addresses redirected, and the paths auth must leave open

boards.description: The owner's collections of the app's items: boards with notes in SQLite, their routes (idempotent saves, where an item is saved, optional suggestions) and MCP tools

testing.description: Checks for an app's tests: lintOpenApi, guideRoutes, guideGaps, toolRoutes

search-client.description: Browser, no framework: a typed client for vector-search's routes, a controller for one search's state (debounced, cancelling), paste and drop of pictures

search-react.description: Browser, React: useVectorSearch, usePictureInput, useSimilar over search-client; headless, each app draws its own UI

vector-search-ui.description: Browser, React + shadcn: an optional search block (field with a picture chip, look/meaning switch, results grid) over search-react

boards-client.description: Browser, no framework: a typed client for the board routes

boards-react.description: Browser, React: useBoards, useItemBoards over boards-client (headless)
